Can you chase wealth and still keep your peace? Most people think you must pick one.

Kevin Trudeau points out that some people are driven by money and lose touch with love, while others are spiritual and flat broke. The distinction, he says, is one word: detachment.

He explains that using things and loving people, instead of using people and loving things, is where real freedom comes from.

Where in your life are you more attached to things than to people?

#ad #success #mindset #wealth

The worst recession in decades, and his profits kept climbing. How?

Kevin Trudeau tells the story of his friend Ed Foreman, whose accountant showed him growth in every business he owned: concrete, real estate, oil and gas, restaurants. The accountant asked how that was possible in a terrible economy.

Ed's answer was simple: "I just chose not to participate." Kevin says that is what it comes down to.

What would change if you chose not to participate in the panic?

#ad #business #success #mindset

If you only teach children one thing about success, what should it be?

Kevin Trudeau says the number one lesson he teaches his sons is attitude and effort. Good day or bad day, hit or strikeout, it doesn't matter. Show up, work hard, work on your skills.

The outcomes come with time, but without the right attitude and effort, he says, the outcome is impossible.

Which of the two do you need more of today?
